newsitem.title: USA: Spinnaker Industries Inc Q4 loss vs net.
newsitem.headline: Spinnaker Industries Inc Q4 loss vs net.

text.p: NOTE: (1) Includes the operations of Central Products Company, Inc. from Oct. 4, 1995, the date its assets and business were acquired from Alco Standard Co.
(2) 1996 includes outsourcing penalties of approximately $600,000 and $2.3 million, in the three month and twelve month periods, respectively, related to silicone coating capacity constraints.

(3) Cost of sales and SG&A include employee severance and relocation costs totaling approximately $265,000 and $736,000, in the three month and twelve month periods, respectively, associated with certain management changes at Brown-Bridge.

(4) Included in the fourth quarter and the year ended December 31, 1996 is the cost of contributing land, held in other assets, to a charitable organization. The book value of the land was approximately $250,000.
(5) The year ended 1995 tax provision has been reduced by $279,000 due to the reversal of the company's valuation allowance related to net deferred tax assets.
(7) Adjusted to reflect a stock dividend effective August 5, 1996, an effective two-for-one split of common stock.
